title: Horarios y actividades diarias
communication_goal: Hablar de horarios y actividades habituales durante todo el día.
situation: Comparas tu horario de trabajo o estudio con el de otra persona.

vocabulary.example: I go to bed at ten.

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.english: What time do you start work?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.english: I start work at nine and finish at five.
dialogue.spanish: Empiezo a trabajar a las nueve y termino a las cinco.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.english: I have lunch at noon. Then I go home at six.
dialogue.spanish: Almuerzo al mediodía. Después voy a casa a las seis.

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.english: What time do you go to bed?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.english: I go to bed at ten.

explanation_es: Para horarios usa What time...? o When...? y responde con at + hora: I start at nine. Para un periodo usa from...to...: I work from nine to five. Las partes del día suelen usar in: in the afternoon, in the evening; pero noon y night tienen expresiones fijas: at noon, at night.
spanish_speaker_notes: No uses in nine o on nine; la hora usa at nine.
Have lunch es la expresión habitual, no eat lunch en todos los casos.
Go home no necesita to: I go home, pero I go to the office.
Go to bed significa acostarse, no simplemente ir hacia una cama.

targets.text: I start work at nine and finish at five.
I go to bed at ten.

pronunciation.tip_es: Marca las horas con claridad; en conversaciones de horarios una cifra mal entendida cambia el plan.

reading.title: Omar's workday
reading.text: Omar starts work at nine and finishes at five. He has lunch at noon. In the afternoon, he goes home and makes dinner. He usually goes to bed at ten.
